title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.117
exact_target: Ask whether simple groups and hereditarily just-infinite groups can have exponential growth whose rate becomes arbitrarily close to one as the generators change.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2626 (KOU-21.117). CC BY 4.0.
E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (editors), The Kourovka Notebook, Unsolved Problems in Group Theory, No.21, version48 (6 October2026), Problem 21.117 and its remarks.
